items.title: Holding Up a Star Mobile
items.alt: A woman holds a hanging mobile of six-pointed stars while a child in a kippah works at a craft table, in black-and-white line art.
items.description: The completed stars hang at staggered heights below a circular mobile frame. Beside the standing woman, the child threads another star above a tabletop scattered with beads, thread and spare shapes.

items.title: Sharing Hanukkah Gelt with a Child
items.alt: An older woman offers a patterned pouch of chocolate coins to a child in a kippah beside a stool with a dreidel and candles, in line art.
items.description: The seated woman supports the small pouch while lifting a coin from its opening. The child holds both hands out toward her, with a dreidel and nine-candle holder on a separate wooden stool.
